title: Picture cards: key, donkey, grey, they
subject: English
source: Seeded from english/y1 lesson 95 (Picture cards: key, donkey, grey, they)
intro: Lesson 95: ey says /ai/: they, grey and obey. To understand that ey can say /ai/ in words such as they and grey

blocks.title: Sort into: /ai/ as in they / /ee/ as in key
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: /ai/ as in they, /ee/ as in key.
blocks.answer: /ai/ as in they: grey; obey; prey. /ee/ as in key: monkey; donkey; chimney
